Paris hotel prices: median $105 a night with taxes and fees, 18 hotels priced Sep 25, 2026

These prices were read on September 25, 2026 for a stay of Oct 30 to Nov 1, 2026, which has passed. Check today's price for your dates

Paris's median: $105 a night all-in, at 16 hotels for 2 adults, from $83 at Glint Paris to $246 at Crowne Plaza Paris - Republique by IHG.

Check a Paris hotel for your dates or check any hotel's price

Google Hotels returned these 18 Paris hotels, on 58 booking sites; Paris's median was tied for the 2nd lowest of the 25 cities priced that day. Listed prices only: MEININGER Hotel Paris Porte de Vincennes and Hôtel Mercure Paris Boulogne.

Our search was "hotels in Paris". By their names, 5 of the 18 are at one of the Portes on the edge of the city and 5 are in La Defense, Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boulogne or Clichy, outside the city limits. So the median is the price of this mix, which leans to the edge of Paris and its suburbs. Airports of Paris: Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly (ORY). The local currency is the euro (EUR); the prices here are in US dollars, as a US visitor saw them.

The booking sites at Paris hotels

58 sites, 11 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Booking.com at 18, Agoda at 17, Etrip.net at 16, Hotels.com at 16, Super.com at 16 and Vio.com at 16. Fewest sites: Glint Paris (8); most: B&B HOTEL Paris 17 Batignolles (28).

Booking.com was lowest at Glint Paris and Generator Paris of its 18, and 5%+ above another site at 16. Agoda was lowest at Hôtel la Régence, Campanile Prime Porte d'Italie and Hôtel Atrium by HappyCulture of its 17, and 5%+ above another site at 14. Etrip.net was lowest at Best Western Hôtel Rives de Paris La Défense of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 10.

The hotel's own site, at 13 of the 18: lowest at 3 (Generator Paris, MEININGER Hotel Paris Porte de Vincennes and The People Belleville), a median 24% above the lowest site. Nearest: Best Western Hôtel Rives de Paris La Défense, $95 against $91 on Vio.com, goseek.com and Etrip.net. Farthest: Novotel Paris Est, $126 against $82 on Amimir.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Billabook.com at 5, Super.com at 4, Agoda at 3, Amimir.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1, Pilot at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Taxes and fees in Paris

They added a median of 24.2% ($21 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 7.6% at Generator Paris to 31.5% at TRIBE Paris La Défense Esplanade; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 2 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Paris, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Paris hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 3 up, 2 down of 6; rose most Glint Paris, $112 to $214; fell most Hôtel d'Orsay, $604 to $522; another site lowest at 2.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 4 up, 4 down of 18; rose most Glint Paris, $70 to $82; fell most Generator Paris, $79 to $70; another site lowest at 10.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about Paris hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Paris?

$105 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $83 at Glint Paris to $246 at Crowne Plaza Paris - Republique by IHG.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Paris?

No: these prices come from a few Paris dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 4 Paris hotels rose more than 2%, 4 fell; Glint Paris rose most, $70 to $82 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Paris hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Billabook.com (5 hotels), Super.com (4 hotels) and Agoda (3 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at 3 of 13.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.

Nearest medians to Paris's: Fort Lauderdale $112, New Orleans $143, Orlando $145, New York $191.
